header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, KARACHI
Date Order with signature of Judge
Mr. Jamsheed Malik, for the plaintiff.
Mr. Naveedul Haq, for the defendants.
body: By order dated 22.10.2007, this Court had framed three issues and had directed that list of witnesses and documents and application for commissioner, if any, within one month.

Learned advocate for the defendant has informed this Court that since 22.10.2007 he is trying to prepare draft issues which he could not prepare till date as the defendants' representative is out of country. Be that as it may, I appoint Mr. Abdul Aziz Memon, ex-District & Sessions Judge, as Commissioner for recording evidence of the respective parties in the matter. The fee of the learned Commissioner is fixed at Rs.5,000/- per witness, to be paid by the respective parties for their witnesses. The learned Commissioner is directed to submit his report within four months as it is an old case of 2005.

Learned counsel for the defendants in the meantime can submit any proposed fresh issue, if he so desires. The submission of issue will not cause delay in recording of evidence. The learned Commissioner should proceed with recording of evidence.
